_comment: Sokoban v0.1 — FOUNDATION ONLY. Conditional movement rules (push, walls, win) are v0.2 work, gated on engine-level decision: (a) make signal+payload+_origin_position workaround viable for cell-grid queries OR (b) ADR 0008 for cell-grid primitives. See docs/games/sokoban/rules-sketch.md for the design. v0.1 only ships a tick-counter so the engine has at least one rule registered (else scheduler may complain).
